l-e-m2-b05-21.s.s1.r.c: Kalkula totál ho loos, maibé valór iha ② mak sala.
l-e-m2-b05-21.s.s1.r.d: ② sala tanba twice as many signifika dala 2.
l-e-m2-b05-21.s.s1.explain: twice as many signifika dala 2. Parte daruak mak 12 × 2 = pontu 24, no totál mak pontu 36.
l-e-m2-b05-21.s.s2.model.0: Tanba twice as many signifika dala 2, tenke 12 × 2 = 24, la'ós 12 + 2, tanba ne'e ② sala.
l-e-m2-b05-21.s.s2.model.1: Iha ②, adisaun fó pontu 14, nune'e fatin ne'e mak sala dahuluk.
